wrong_turns: Removing a rider before the other deck is ready may leave the clutch in WAIT FOR BOTH; the actual response and recovery are untested.
Abandoning the single sac on the wrong side could block a glucose-dependent transfer; its exact necessity is unknown.
unknowns: The control panel changes naturally from WAIT FOR BOTH to MOVING and END STOP while no keys are pressed, so it demonstrates cycle states, not human control.
It is unclear which deck, if either, needs the sac throughout the crossing and where the couriers exchange sides.
There are large pits below the decks; failed departures and resets are unobserved.
0/0 sparks shows no visible collectible quota. Shared-keyboard friction remains untested; one-operator simultaneous control is separate.
